[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''B. Hensworth''' was a member of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] who worked with [[Magister of Trade]] [[Sinya Deboora]] after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the overthrowing of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltos]], and the established of a pro-[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government, the pair sought to return the planet to Imperial control. Going into hiding at a secret Imperial base west of [[Sommin City]], Hensworth was still able to maintain contact with Deboora by promising her the Governorship if they regained control of the planet. However, when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] began Operation [[Freedom Strike Seltos]], an effort to locate a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] within the new government's ranks, their plot was thwarted.
